caption: The video showcases a silver mesh-grille microphone standing upright at the center of a cylindrical vessel built from densely packed magnetic spheres, set against a draped white cloth. Two hands grip the top of a vertical chain of matching spheres from the upper corners. In the opening frames these chains run tautly down to the rim on opposite sides. The left hand eases downward, slackening its chain so the strand curves and settles along the left rim. The right hand follows, lowering in turn so the second chain bends and drapes over the right edge. Both hands continue moving down and inward, the flexible strands deforming from straight lines into curved lengths lying against the container's outer walls. Near the close the fingers open and drift toward the frame edges. The chains are left resting over the rim while the microphone and sphere-built vessel remain fixed in place.
